items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Instead, they got Bobby ten Rosengard and -- to make the short gigs

ctx.x: And Dick would. He would -- because I was the drummer in the band, see. Instead, they got Bobby ten Rosengard and -- to make the short gigs, and when they'd come
out here, they'd want me to play, see. But I wouldn't do it like that.
